name: TrustDemoDT04
title: TD.DT.04 Is this dose of the national schedule due?
description: For one action of the national schedule, decide whether the evaluation recommends it now, and from which date. Requirements: STD-SCH-001. Hit policy FIRST: the rules are tried in order and the first that matches applies.

action.title: Rule 1
action.description: When counted is true: forecast = complete. J3: the Hep B and BCG birth doses count once imported, so they are not recommended again (STD-SCH-001).

action.title: Rule 2
action.description: When counted is false and isNextVisit is true: forecast = due; dueDate = birthDate + timingAge. J3: pentavalent 1, bOPV 1 and PCV 1 at 6 weeks, due 2025-12-09 (ImmunizationRecommendation TrustDemoJ3Recommendation), with a reminder Task for that date.

action.title: Rule 3
action.description: When counted is false and isNextVisit is false: forecast = not-yet. J3: measles-rubella 1 at 9 months belongs to a later visit and is not in this recommendation.
